prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create one complete, flat, opaque 16:9 landscape poster for a weekend houseplant market, suitable for an SNS post. The relationship between choosing a living plant and the light it will live with is the visual idea.

Input image 1 is an authored planning diagram only: refer to its mature actual-copy letter anatomy, broad paragraph area, paired practical rows, and continuous spatial relationship. It is not finished artwork, a palette reference, a protected coordinate layout or a client plant asset. Replace its neutral planes and schematic oval leaves with the following substantive botanical light study. Do not print any planning metadata.

Whole image: a boldly reduced, observed domestic scene, edited into large precise graphic tonal shapes. A close cropped window jamb and sill enter at the upper right. Beneath it stands a mature upright rubber plant in a dense rust terracotta pot with a legible elliptical rim, soil, connected branching stems and distinctly shaped living leaves. A second smaller planted pot sits farther from this window, at the left, visibly in the same space at another position. Show actual plant structure, spatial support and pot contact. No labels or health comparison. One coherent daylight direction arrives from the upper right; pot shadows, stem shadows and botanical leaf silhouettes stretch obliquely down-left, attached to their sources, with compressed but credible shape correspondence. The shadow structure must be a substantial part of the whole composition, not a tiny decoration or plant border. Retain a hard diagonal light edge with only a small, observed degree of softness in cast-shadow edges.

Color and finish: near-black charcoal-green wall tone, muted warm apricot daylight plane, concentrated dark rust pottery, selected deep green leaf surfaces and warm ivory upper typography. Strong bounded tonal reduction, quiet matte surfaces, deliberate botanical contours; no foggy wash, fake paper noise, toy/clay forms or decorative tape. The oblique light/shadow field should cross most of the page and organize it as a single space, not as separate rectangular background panels or a pale hole framed with foliage.

Typography and reading route: the slogan is the first, largest type anchor, across the stable upper dark tone. The smaller Korean identity and its close Latin companion sit at the upper-left image edge, clearly subordinate to the slogan. Under the slogan, give the full explanation a broad upright left-aligned three-line paragraph, keeping the whole paragraph on one steady dark tone and every glyph free of shadow/light-boundary crossings. Use the guide's meaningful three-line grouping. The paragraph is substantial reading matter, with moderate medium weight, generous normal word spaces and steady comfortable line spacing. Its last-line end meets the descending light boundary, which leads the eye down-left to the beginning of a wide lateral visit crossbar in a quiet portion of the warm light plane.
The crossbar is flat typesetting within the continuous image, with the market name on the left and date to its right in one row; hours and venue occupy the immediately following paired row. Access and care occupy the close following row, then invitation and adjacent URL underneath. These are naturally connected practical information, not detached corner captions or a tiny footer. Leave both pot bases and attached shadows visible, and shape the shadow silhouettes around, rather than through, the readable practical rows.
At a 720-pixel-wide SNS viewing assumption, full prose and all practical information must be comfortably readable with high contrast and substantial body anatomy. Use refined mature Korean sans forms, open counters, stable consonant/vowel proportions and stroke joins, moderate weight, proportional Latin and legible numerals, horizontal baselines. Keep body and practical copy clean and precise even where imagery is tonal. Preserve meaningful word spacing, the ampersand, middle dots, colons, periods, slash and specifically the two en-dash range signs; distinguish the range dash from a hyphen by visible length and position. Do not distort or ornament the characters.

Print only these twelve entries, each once, with exact spelling, capitalization, numbers, punctuation and word spaces. Soft wrapping is allowed at word boundaries; no fixed line breaks are requested:
집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.

The choosing-and-caring concept must be carried by substantive nonglyph plants, positions, light and connected shadows. Exclude passive solid, near-solid or split-field headline/date/information templates with subordinate small images, texture substitutions or empty-room dressing. The continuous oblique scene must genuinely determine the typography and reading route. No new copy, extra label, logo, QR, watermark, plant-tag lettering, style title, mockup, frame, comparison panels or contact sheet. Exactly one complete poster, opaque background.
